Lemma
[The differential of the inclusion of an open subset]

An open $W\subseteq \mathbb R^n$ is a smooth manifold with $T_xW\cong \mathbb R^n$, and under this identification $d\iota _x=\operatorname {id}$; hence $\iota $ is an immersion.

Proof

\sketch In the single inclusion chart of $W$, the coordinate representative is the identity on a neighbourhood of each point, so its differential is the identity.

□
